nav.about: Hello, I'm Yuri Cruz, and I've always been passionate about creating things. Combining this with technology is what led me to become a Full Stack Developer. Building products for all types of users and providing good experiences is what I enjoy the most.

about.title: About Me
about.description1: I am a full stack developer, and my work is focused on solving problems, preferably using the web, while understanding that different challenges may require different solutions.
about.description2: I value clean code, intuitive design, and best development practices to build applications that not only work, but also leave users satisfied.
about.description3: Accessibility, performance, practicality, and scalability are the pillars that guide my development decisions.
